subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Nagaland.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Kohima. Nagaland covers a geographic area of 16,579 sq km across 16 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Doyang, Dhansiri, Dikhu, Tizu.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Known as the 'Land of Festivals'. Home to 16 recognized indigenous major tribes, famous for the world-renowned Hornbill Festival celebrated annually from December 1 to 10.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Nagaland.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Nagaland was formally instituted on 1 December 1963. Official language(s): English.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: War Dance, Modse, Zeliang dance, Chang Lo.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Hornbill Festival ('Festival of Festivals'), Moatsu (Ao), Sekrenyi (Angami), Tokhu Emong (Lotha).

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Nagaland.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is La. Ganesan.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Nagaland is Neiphiu Rio.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Gauhati High Court (Kohima Bench).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Mithun | State Bird: Blyth's tragopan | State Flower: Tree rhododendron | State Tree: Alder.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Nagaland.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Coal, Limestone, Petroleum (Wokha), Magnetite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Nagaland plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Nagaland.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Kohima War Cemetery (Commonwealth, famous Kohima epitaph), Kachari Ruins at Dimapur, Dzukou Valley.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Ntangki National Park, Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Nagaland.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Chief Minister's Micro Finance Initiative, Chief Minister's Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS).
